GmReadme.Title: GM Eyes Only
GmReadme.Body:
Welcome to Simply Insane Notes


This note was created automatically for the GM only. Feel free to edit or delete it whenever you want.


How it started


Simply Insane Notes was born out of a very real problem: I wanted a decent notepad that got straight to the point and stayed out of the way during sessions. At first it was meant to be just a simple project, a quick workaround to tame the mess of loose notes, ideas, and references piling up while prepping the game. Then I ran into a wall: every single notes module for Foundry is terrible to use.

The real push came from Fallen Kingdom, an original campaign I have been building with blood, sweat, tears and other fluids for nearly a year. When you dive headfirst into the trauma of building a campaign with over 10 countries, a boatload of NPCs, and a living world built for maximum exploration, I felt I had to give my players decent tools to jot down clues, build mind maps, and follow the story. The focus really was on the players — giving them something solid to work with at the table. Of course the GM can use it too, but that was the main goal.

Over time, what started as a tiny notepad kept growing: I thought about adding this, then that, piling on improvements to make something genuinely cool and useful not just for my table, but for anyone who wants to use it. Since I am a programmer whose career has always focused on backend development, tackling a ton of frontend JavaScript in Foundry VTT on a tight schedule would have been brutal — so I brought in Gemini to help unlock that side and get the rest of the ideas off the ground.

(Hope you don't mind.)

Enjoy the module and have fun with the features!


Tips & features


Navigation & shortcuts


Default shortcuts: Alt+N (Manager), Alt+F (Global Search), and Alt+M (Quick Note).
Locate note: hold Shift when clicking the manager button (or right-click it) to jump straight to the current note's folder.
First-run language: on first launch, you pick your language before initial data is created, and you can change it anytime in the settings.

Writing, links & media


Mentions & Links: type @ to mention players and use the context menu to link other notes, tables, callout boxes, or special blocks.
Images: paste or drag images right into a note or mind map, resize them, switch sides, or crop them directly in the editor.
Mind maps: visually organize ideas, nodes, connections, and linked notes on the canvas.

Backup & server maintenance


Full backup: in the manager settings, you can export all notes and images from the world and restore them into another game while mapping players.
Image cleanup: whenever you paste or upload an image, the module saves the file directly inside the module's folder in your world so it doesn't bloat the database or server with heavy embedded data. Over time, images from edited or deleted notes can pile up there — that's what the scripts in the cleanup/ folder (Win and Linux, with a README.txt explaining everything) are for. Totally optional, though recommended every now and then.


Spread the word


If Simply Insane Notes helps you or your table, share it with fellow GMs and players, show it off in your sessions or clips, and help spread the word about the project. If you want to roast or praise me, my Telegram is t.me/insane_heart (ps: I barely reply over there anyway, XD).
And if you'd like to give the project some extra love and buy me a coffee, here's my Ko-fi: ko-fi.com/insaneheart

Note
This code and content are not AI-free. Use if you want.
(even though I don't like letting AI write code for me, I left this to finish way too last-minute so there was no way around it)
